entries.ai_recommendation_summary: ChatGPT recommended an Always-On Sandbox for quick shared API exploration.
entries.rationale: The team needs immediate shared access for read-only API practice. An Always-On Sandbox is suitable because it provides shared access without requiring administrative control.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: ChatGPT recommended a Reservation Sandbox for private configuration testing.
entries.rationale: The development team needs private access and administrative control to test configuration changes. A Reservation Sandbox is more suitable for this requirement.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: ChatGPT recommended a Learning Lab for guided API concept practice.
entries.rationale: The user is a beginner who needs structured and step-by-step learning content. A Learning Lab is appropriate because learning is the main requirement.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: ChatGPT recommended Code Exchange for reusable automation examples.
entries.rationale: The developer needs to examine existing community and Cisco-maintained code repositories. Code Exchange is appropriate because it provides automation examples and existing code.
